# HarnessDock v0.2.5

v0.2.5 completes the Tauri client lifecycle hardening and publishes the first release-optimized Android package.

## Client lifecycle

- Keeps Harness Web as the primary desktop surface while retaining an immediately usable startup control page and boot status animation.
- Adds a prewarmed, on-demand Shell Settings plugin with Runtime recovery, restart, update check and explicit stop actions.
- Adds a custom Harness toolbar for settings, minimize, maximize/restore and hide-to-tray actions.
- Closing a desktop window hides it to the system tray; only the explicit tray exit action stops Gateway/Runtime and terminates HarnessDock.
- Detects an unexpectedly exited Runtime child process, prevents duplicate concurrent Runtime starts and stops Gateway before Runtime restart.
- Keeps Android/iOS remote-only and excludes desktop resources from mobile bundles.

## Android package

- Changes the Android candidate path to Tauri's default release build mode.
- Adds release profile optimization: size-oriented optimization, Thin LTO, symbol stripping, one codegen unit and abort-on-panic.
- The verified Android smoke APK is approximately 7.8 MB, with the largest native library approximately 5.3 MB; package size is enforced in CI.

## Update and verification

- Settings provides a safe stable-release check and official GitHub Release link without interrupting the running client.
- Release publishing requires the exact same-SHA green candidate and CI results, and includes SHA256SUMS.
- Public artifacts remain unsigned developer builds; production desktop in-place updates still require signing keys and updater metadata.
